name: Large Candle
summary: In Elwynn's mines, kobolds carry Large Candles on their heads for light and wax. Their flames guide them through dark tunnels, and apothecaries value the wax.

sections.title: Subterranean Light and Wax
sections.body: Kobolds use candle flame to find their way through the dark shafts beneath Elwynn Forest. They fasten the tapers to their heads, and Kobold Miners, Tunnelers, and Geomancers defend them fiercely from intruders. Though crudely made, the Large Candles carried in Fargodeep Mine and Jasperlode Mine hold valuable wax. Surface tradesmen cannot easily produce it in bulk, so the candles are both tools for the kobolds and a commodity for alchemists.

sections.title: Trade and the Apothecary
sections.body: William Pestle, an apothecary operative from Stormwind City, gathers Large Candles at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. His family runs an apothecary, and he needs rendered wax for its concoctions, balms, and ointments. Pestle hires passing adventurers to clear the infested mines and take candles from the kobolds.

faq.q: What are Large Candles used for?
faq.answer: William Pestle collects Large Candles in Goldshire for the apothecary he runs with his brother in Stormwind City. They render the candles down for wax used in ointments, balms, and alchemical recipes.

faq.q: Where can Large Candles be found?
faq.answer: Kobolds carry Large Candles in Elwynn Forest's mines, especially Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire and Jasperlode Mine to the east. Tunnelers, Miners, and Geomancers carry them.

faq.q: Why do kobolds carry candles on their heads?
faq.answer: Kobolds use candlelight to dig and find their way through dark underground tunnels. They fasten candles to their heads to keep their hands free for pickaxes, geomantic spellcasting, and weapons.

aliases: who is the apothecary guy in goldshire
faq.answer: William Pestle is an apothecary operative from Stormwind City who conducts business at Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn. He gathers raw ingredients from the wilderness and mines to supply the apothecary shop he runs with his brother.

angles.text: Miners working the veins in Fargodeep and Jasperlode regularly run afoul of kobold infestations that covet both the gold and the light of Large Candles.
By taking candles from kobolds in Elwynn, Alliance adventurers weaken the vermin in the mines and supply critical materials to Stormwind's apothecary trade.
